meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: Claude 可以驱动浏览器替你做事:打开网址、点击、填写表单、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网页应用。任务被拆成小脚本逐步执行,页面状态在脚本之间保留,不必每次从头再来。
howto.when: 当你要求导航网站、填表单、截图或做任何浏览器交互时接管,例如说出 “go to [url]”、“click on”、“scrape” 等。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,告诉我页面标题
say.note: 用独立 Chromium 打开新页面并返回标题

say.text: 登录这个网站,然后截一张当前页面截图
say.note: 可连接你已登录的 Chrome 扩展模式

say.text: 把这个列表页的数据抓下来
say.note: 原文建议抓大数据时拦截并重放网络请求

howto.what_en: Claude drives a browser for you: opening sites, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, scraping web data and testing web apps. Work runs as small scripts, and page state persists between script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to navigate a site, fill a form, take a screenshot, extract web data, or any browser interaction — e.g. "go to [url]", "click on", "scrape".

say_en.text: Go to https://example.com and tell me the page title
say_en.note: Opens a fresh Chromium page and returns the title

say_en.text: Log into this site, then take a screenshot
say_en.note: Can use Extension Mode on your logged-in Chrome

say_en.text: Scrape the data from this list page
say_en.note: Docs suggest replaying network requests for large data
